Message:
One day, just like any other day,
I was visiting Yubera’s house,

when I found her lying on the bed,
her face deathly pale.
“It looks like...this is it for me...”

The light that had been
spilling out of her fingertips
was now overflowing
from her entire body,
rapidly burning through
the little life essence
she had left.
“I never got to finish my painting...”

I reached for my chest
and touched the flower.
She gave me this flower
so I can die.

If it can put a stop
to my immortality,
then it should be able to do
the same to Yubera’s power.

But, it’s nearly lost all its color,
so I’m sure using it now would
consume every ounce of
its power...to make it
wither away completely...

“No... I’m not the kind of
person worth saving...

Yubera then weakly
shut her eyes in protest.

I don’t know anything
about the despair
she had to suffer through.

When someone closes off
their heart, no amount of
kind words will ever reach them.

But, I do know the type of
selfish kindness that can
pry that type of heart right open.

“If you’re gonna die anyway,
why not give your life
over to me?”

Yubera slowly opens her eyes.
Then, gazes into mine,
and smiles.

“If I’m giving it
over to you, Fia...
Sure.”
